metadata.projection_type: workload heuristic; full PPR; see report limitations

confidence.meaning: Historical rate that next-four-week average PPR per scheduled team game is within +/-5 of the projection; not rank correctness.

injury_filter.rule: Exclude the entire player season after any documented injury/illness absence in a scheduled regular-season game.
injury_filter.evidence: Medical injury report Out with no participation-stat row; Questionable/Doubtful plus inactive roster with no stat row; medical reserve (IR/PUP/NFI) with no stat row. Rest, personal matters and suspension alone do not qualify.
injury_filter.interpretation: Retrospective healthy-season conditioning: future full-season injury outcomes determine eligibility. Confidence excludes future injury risk and can be more optimistic than an unconditional forecast. Unrecorded injury absences may remain.

confidence.range: Empirical 10th-90th percentile residual range; 80% target coverage, not guaranteed.
confidence.caveat: Forecast windows overlap and players repeat; sample counts are not independent trials. When injury seasons are excluded, confidence is conditional on no documented injury absence over the whole season, not an unconditional live forecast probability.
